scope: Muse remotely upgrades two existing physical phones from code62 to code63 and verifies a limited task on each original connection.
evidence_source: Actual Muse cloud-runner report received in its original conversation; private transcript retained outside the public repository.
delegation: Owner-authorized maintainer sent the ordinary task through the normal Muse composer; not represented as personally typed by the owner.

devices.label: phone_a
retained_failures_and_recovery: Opening the download required a fresh observation; observed then retried.
A storage-permission tap returned an unknown result; state and a new image confirmed permission and the completed download, without blindly replaying the tap.
Installation disconnected the channel with 410; waited 20 seconds, reconnected using the original configuration, and confirmed code63.

devices.label: phone_b
retained_failures_and_recovery: After approximately two hours idle, the first image showed the lock-screen notification shade. A ready status did not establish that the launcher was foreground; a swipe only scrolled notifications, then Back exposed the browser.
A storage-permission tap returned an unknown result; a fresh observation confirmed it had applied.
Download stalled for approximately 55 seconds; reopening the same verified artifact URL with a candidate=1 query completed in approximately 10 seconds.
File-manager launch returned a transport 503, then required observation after reconnect; a fresh observation allowed progress.
Installation disconnected the channel with 410; waited 20 seconds, reconnected using the original configuration, and confirmed code63.

not_claimed: Physical-phone short-code pairing or new Instinct phone approval
Current-version two-AI handoff or replacement of a cloud execution environment
Reboot without system authentication, multi-day background reliability, or independent first-user onboarding
Retirement of the remaining legacy phone control chain
